verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS fraud-prevention platform, but the evidence never mentions a self-hosted or on-prem deployment. It describes only a vendor-run service: merchants send order data to Riskified's REST endpoints, receive decisions back, and Riskified's own team calibrates models and handles go-live.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
